scope: CVG-004 bounded explicit worker report actor configuration and fail-closed deployment wiring

criteria.description: The worker currently falls back from WORKER_REPORTS_USER_ID to accountId in continuous and one-shot scheduled report paths, while report_executions requires a users foreign key.
criteria.limitations: The finding is bounded to actor selection; it does not authorize report-schema, service-principal or audit-model changes.

criteria.description: The bounded correction has a disjoint implementation surface: shared worker config, one worker identity helper, two worker entrypoints, canonical Compose/Helm wiring and focused unit/process/static tests.
criteria.limitations: No code, deployment or provider mutation is authorized beyond the listed repository-local files and tests.

criteria.description: TDD can reject missing/malformed configuration, account-id fallback, unknown foreign-key actors and missing production-like Secret wiring before implementation.
criteria.limitations: Implementation, fresh disposable PostgreSQL proof, independent critique and post-fix quality rails remain required before bounded reconciliation.

gaps: The identity helper, configuration field, entrypoint wiring, deployment templates and rejecting tests are not implemented at gate creation.
Per-account service-principal provisioning and scheduled audit append remain outside this slice.
conditions: Do not put a user UUID or credential in the repository; production-like identity must come from operator-managed configuration.
Do not change report schema, create users, call providers or mutate target/production state.
Retain the global CVG-004 and ERP program as IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL regardless of bounded evidence.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded explicit worker report actor configuration and fail-closed deployment wiring
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository-local worker/config/deployment-template/test implementation and disposable PostgreSQL/real worker verification. Exclude report schema/audit-model changes, service-principal provisioning, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing report identity/schema/audit semantics, provisioning service principals, operating a target or production environment, or expanding report scope.

next_action: Write and run the focused configuration/identity RED tests, then implement the smallest fail-closed resolver and deployment wiring.
